scope: Extension of the fixed 14-image/10-visual-color study: three visible face orientations, six books. Fixed geometry and 63x59 pixels; repeat books are not independent material samples.
selection: Main top patch chosen geometrically between studs; front cap is a separate check, not pooled into the main top estimate. Same coordinates for all 14 images.
limits: Decoded native sRGB image values, not original shader parameters or physical material reflectance.
Top patch is only 30 pixels; JPEG/block noise and neighboring ink affect saturated colors. Half-integer medians are not half-level measurement accuracy.
One-pixel shifts are sensitivity controls, not confidence intervals or independent renders.
Upper planar face and cap checked at one orientation; no recovered light direction or universal shading formula.
